name: l4-binding-decision
summary: `int(data.get("port", ...))` raises ValueError or TypeError for a bad port, against B2 (`load` never raises; None on bad input)
probe:
from config import load
for text in ('{"host": "a", "port": "x"}', '{"host": "a", "port": null}',
             '{"host": "a", "port": [1]}'):
    assert load(text) is None, text
